provenance_note: Frozen categorical references recorded from two independently authored corpora (the 45 rule scenarios of the previous release and the 2.0 corpus written from SPEC-changeimpact.md); this run executes the shipping build against those stored expectations and does not re-derive them from the tool under test.
reference: Forty-five exact scenarios covering impact propagation, late-change evidence invalidation, closure gating and termination behaviour, exercising every impact area across the full range of classifications the model can produce. Version 2.0 corpus: Rule-matrix corpus for the Design Change Impact Mapper 2.0: the three owner presets of TZ-01 (identical replacement as a replacement-in-kind candidate whose review obligations remain, pump retrofit with hydraulics/power/interface/document/test areas, temporary jumper with unknown safety effect and open return obligations); every screening row including like_for_like failing each of its four conditions; family seeds, rules R01-R45 and the emergency/temporary process rules with max-rank interaction; two-pass propagation with attenuation, depth cap, cycle termination and edge provenance (built-in vs custom), hand-counted edge totals; the eight ordered closure checks, explicit evidence statuses, overrides and the rule that an unknown interface cannot be closed as unknown; every input gap and parameter gap with near-misses, locale number formats, invalid dates and every range form; the three independent states with approval binding and staleness; restore of invalid imported states; and the blank state.
tolerance: Exact categorical/boolean equality; one action-text containment check. Version 2.0 corpus: exact categorical match; every expect key is one graded check (classification/absent/levels/issues/no_issues/gap_ids/no_gap_ids/edges/restore_notes per entry); issues, gap_ids, edges and restore_notes are membership checks (listed items must be present, other items may also be present); edge fields given must match exactly; edge_count and closed_count are exact integers.

not_benchmarked: maintainability / affected - unreachable: no level-0 rule emits `affected` for maintainability (R16 and R29 emit `probably`) and propagation only attenuates, so the model cannot reach this cell without a reviewer override, which is a user input rather than a model output.
spares / affected - unreachable: only R16 and R19 seed spares, both at `probably`; every dependency edge into spares originates at equipment and attenuates.
training / affected - unreachable: only R11, R21 and R41 seed training, all at `probably`; the commissioning->training edge attenuates.
permits / affected - unreachable: only R12, R26 and R28 seed permits, all at `probably`; the construction->permits edge attenuates.
cost / affected - unreachable: only R05 and R44 seed cost, both at `probably`; the procurement->cost and schedule->cost edges attenuate.

drawings / na, equipment / na, software / na - not benchmarked: `na` is a reviewer disposition applied by one closure routine (closureCheck), already benchmarked on fifteen other areas and on both of its validity branches and all three of its rejection branches. No scenario in this corpus can declare drawings, equipment or application software *inapplicable* while still placing them in the impact map without asserting an engineering falsehood, so the cell is left open rather than faked.

Area/outcome cells are reported against the five classifications the model can hold (affected, probably, unknown, no_impact, na). `unknown` is never reachable through a reviewer disposition: closureCheck rejects an `unknown` closure outright (issue `unknown_close`, benchmarked in invalid-closure-dispositions), so every `unknown` cell in the matrix is an engine result.
Several valid override rows on one area with different classifications (rev .2 does not say which wins).
Numbers with a single separator followed by exactly three digits that cannot be a thousands group, e.g. 0.125 or 1234.567: the literal rev .2 §8 wording refuses them as ambiguous; not asserted.
Hyphen ranges whose bounds contain an exponent (e.g. 1e-3-5).
Whether a review row with an unrecognised status value or an unknown classification value is accepted or reported under restore.
Absence of a field from restore_notes (format only checks presence), e.g. parameters:null not named.
Unit-list notices (never gaps) and the content of human-readable reasons, paths and notices.
Fingerprint key-order independence (not expressible in this corpus format).
Learn mode, presets UI, PDF, Python export, localisation, project-package integration.
